record each verdict rests on. **Pre-silicon:** every figure is simulation, static

## Findings

- Row 7: the LibreLane flow places the macro-backed design inside the 2x2 core (58.55 %), yet the tracker keeps the row unmet because DR 0005 (SRAM macro) is unratified and the klt P&R leg has no number; the report follows the tracker and does not pick the LibreLane number as the answer.
- Row 4: LibreLane reports 3 of the 6 declared corners; the klt flow reports none. The two flows therefore do not disagree on a number, but only one has measured anything.

Rows not passing: 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 10, 11, 12.
